name: lv_image_decoder_get_info

ownership.argument: Source is borrowed for this synchronous call; header_out is caller-owned writable storage of at least 12 bytes.
ownership.return_value: Integer result in r0: 1 on success, 0 on failure; no returned ownership.

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP instruction/call-site inspection plus source-compiled Unicorn probes in Canopus-Module-Resource-Hook/tests/firmware_reload.py; see companion evidence for byte-window hashes.

notes: Header cache capacity is read at cache+8 by 0x0c38e3b4. The cache-hit path 0x0c38e3d6..0x0c38e3f4 copies 12 bytes and releases its reference. With nonzero capacity, 0x0c38e47c..0x0c38e4b8 reports failure if insertion fails. With caching disabled, success does not establish a reusable cached header. Native get-info cache-hit/release instructions are emulated in firmware_reload.py; file I/O and decoder callbacks are not hardware validated. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock. Host emulation is not a physical device probe or an approval for general veneer generation.
